sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The gargoyle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Mocking Rebuke (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 60 feet of the gargoyle deals damage to the gargoyle or one of its allies it can see, the gargoyle weaves a magical insult at the creature. If the target can hear the gargoyle (though it need not understand the gargoyle), it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the next time the target makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw before the end of its next turn, it must roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from the result.

sb.name: Gargoyle, Ancient
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The gargoyle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargoyle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The gargoyle glares at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target magically begins turning to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell or other magic.

sb.name: Geode Wurm
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious
sb.senses: tremorsense 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the wurm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate mineral formation.

traits.name: Jagged Body
traits.desc: A creature takes 10 (3d6) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns while grappled by the wurm.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The wurm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Resonant Core
traits.desc: While the wurm has half its hit points or fewer, it loses its vulnerability to thunder damage and its Jagged Body and Magic Resistance traits. Additionally, its AC increases to 19, its walking speed increases by 20 feet, and its burrowing speed decreases by 20 feet.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wurm makes one attack with its grinding jaws and one constrict attack. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Grinding Jaws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15) and pulled 5 feet toward the wurm. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the wurm can't constrict another target.

sb.name: Giant Felsic Crab
sb.damage_resistances: piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the crab has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Rock-Solid Grip
traits.desc: The crab can climb difficult surfaces made of rock or stone, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The crab has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The crab makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained until the grapple ends. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Acrid Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The crab exhales a pungent, caustic spray in a 30-foot cone. The spray destroys any Tiny nonmagical object in the area that isn't being worn or carried. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) acid damage, and any nonmagical armor or shield that the creature is wearing or carrying takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and any armor or shield it is wearing or carrying is unaffected.

sb.name: Giant Gem-nosed Mole
sb.condition_immunities: blinded
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13

traits.name: Adamantine Claws
traits.desc: The mole's claw attacks are magical and deal an extra 4 (1d8) force damage on a hit (included in the attack).

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The mole has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Light Sense
traits.desc: The mole can sense the presence of dim and bright light within 60 feet of it. This sense doesn't extend through opaque obstructions, but can travel around corners and through openings that aren't airtight. Furthermore, the mole can detect and identify any crystals or gemstones lit by dim or bright light that it can sense.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The mole can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mole makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Adamantine Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the goose can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Batter
traits.desc: If the goose is within 5 feet of a prone creature, it can make one attack with its wings against the creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The goose has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goose makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its wings.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wings
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Honk (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The goose releases a terrifying blast of sonic energy. Each creature within 60 feet of it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also frightened until the end of the goose's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature's speed is reduced to 0.

traits.name: Construct Familiar
traits.desc: When Giogroth casts [[Tools/Spells/Find Familiar|find familiar]], he can choose for it to take the form of a flying sword. It uses the normal statistics for a flying sword except it is immune to damage and its attacks are magical.

traits.name: Guardian Amulet
traits.desc: Constructs have disadvantage on attack rolls against Giogroth, and he has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spellcasting

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 5 piercing damage plus 8 acid or poison damage (marshwarden's choice), and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the marshwarden's next turn.

reactions.name: Poisonous Defense (4/Day)
reactions.desc: When an attacker that the marshwarden can see hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attacker takes 11 (1d8 + 7) acid or poison damage (marshwarden's choice).

sb.name: Mimic Cart
sb.condition_immunities: prone

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 15). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.desc: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

sb.name: Mira
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.desc: Once per turn, Mira can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature she hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of Mira that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mira makes three melee attacks: two with her pike and one with her snake hair.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Mira adds 3 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Mira must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, the thief can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the thief is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the thief instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The thief deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the thief that isn't incapacitated and the thief doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Mirrorlight Projection (3/Day)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the thief conjures a perfect illusory clone of itself in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it. The clone has 1 hit point, an AC of 14, and a movement speed of 30 feet. The clone can't take actions, but can move on the thief's turn (not provoking opportunity attacks), and counts as a hostile creature to the thief's enemies. If the thief uses this action while it has a clone projected, the previous clone is dispelled as the new one is created.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. The thief can innately cast minor illusion.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thief makes two weapon attacks. One attack can originate from the thief's clone.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Phantom Swipe
reactions.desc: When a creature the thief can see leaves the thief's reach, the thief causes the clone to make a melee weapon attack (using the thief's Dexterity) against that creature. On a hit, the target creature takes 8 radiant damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The thief halves the damage it takes from an attack made against it, provided it can see the attacker.

sb.name: Muck Ooze
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the ooze is subjected to acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.desc: While enveloping a creature, the ooze takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a puddle of swamp muck.

traits.name: Swamp Stride
traits.desc: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs the ooze no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Envelop
actions.desc: The ooze lunges at a Large or smaller creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the ooze lands in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. On a failed save, the ooze enters the target's space as it envelops the target's body with its mucky form, and the target takes 13 (3d8) acid damage. While enveloped, the target's speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and Dexterity saving throws, and it takes 13 (3d8) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the target moves, the ooze moves with it. If the ooze exits the target's space, the target is no longer enveloped and this effect ends. An enveloped target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the ooze falls to the ground in its space, and the target escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

sb.name: Mycothrall Queen
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Death Spores
traits.desc: When the queen dies, she releases a 10-foot-radius cloud of fungal spores. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is also paralyzed and takes 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns until the poison ends. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Hivemind
traits.desc: The queen is a member of the Mycothrall Hivemind. She can communicate telepathically with any other member of the Hivemind, as long as they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Sunlight Susceptibility
traits.desc: The queen takes 5 (1d10) radiant damage if she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The queen uses her Eject Spores; before or after doing so, she makes one clutch attack.

actions.name: Clutch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is also grappled.

actions.name: Eject Spores
actions.desc: The queen ejects spores at one creature she can see within 15 feet of her, subjecting it to one of the following effects.

actions.name: Blinding Spores
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Horrifying Spores
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Subjugating Spores (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the diseased target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. If the target dies while diseased in this way, it immediately rises as a mycothrall (see the sidebar) and regains all its hit points. The queen has total control of the mycothrall subject.

sb.name: Night Terror
sb.damage_resistances: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The night terror can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form, but it can only use its flying speed in humanoid form if it's polymorphed into a race that is able to fly. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.desc: Creatures within 30 feet of the night terror have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened, and frightened creatures in the aura have disadvantage on saving throws against the night terror's spells and effects. In addition, the night terror gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns for each creature within this aura that is frightened. 14 THE GRIFFON'S SADDLEBAG

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (True Form Only)
traits.desc: The night terror can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The night terror has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The night terror's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The night terror can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Silent Image|silent image]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bane|bane]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]] (as a 2nd-level spell)
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The night terror makes two attacks with its Nightmarish Touch. It can cast a spell in place of one attack.

actions.name: Nightmarish Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit (with advantage if the target is frightened), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Torrent of Terror (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the night terror must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened as it is flooded with horrific visions of its deepest fears. While frightened in this way, the creature's speed is reduced to 0, and it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage if it starts its turn within 30 feet of the night terror. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Apparition (Recharge 5–6)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, or as part of the bonus action the barbarian uses to enter a rage, it can teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is within 5 feet of another creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the barbarian until the start of the barbarian's next turn. A creature frightened in this way can speak only falteringly and can't make opportunity attacks against the barbarian, and the barbarian has advantage on attack rolls against the creature.

traits.name: Rage (3/Day)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the barbarian can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the barbarian is knocked unconscious or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the barbarian gains the following benefits: y It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. y It gains a +2 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack). y The first creature it hits on each of its turns with a weapon attack takes an extra 4 (1d8) psychic damage. y It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the barbarian can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The barbarian makes two attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage while raging.

sb.name: Nightmare Puppeteer
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone, unconscious

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the puppeteer moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the puppeteer and knocked prone.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the puppeteer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The puppeteer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the puppeteer can magically turn invisible until it makes an attack, forces a creature to make a saving throw, or its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any strings the puppeteer has attached to a creature and any equipment the puppeteer wears or carries are invisible with it.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The puppeteer is immune to any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The puppeteer's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). The puppeteer can innately cast the following spells, requiring only somatic components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|burning hands]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]] (4d8)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Color Spray|color spray]] (as a 5th-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Scorching Ray|scorching ray]] (as a 4th-level spell)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Spray|prismatic spray]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The puppeteer makes two slam attacks. It can use its Fling in place of one attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: The puppeteer attempts to flick or throw one creature within 5 feet of it. The target must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is flung up to 60 feet away from the puppeteer and knocked prone, and any strings that were attached to it detach. If the target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: String Up
actions.desc: The puppeteer launches a string from each of its fingertips at one creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, 1d4 + 1 strings attach to the creature's limbs, and the target is restrained. While restrained in this way, the target is moved with the puppeteer as it moves, always staying within 15 feet of the puppeteer. The target can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, breaking free from up to 1d4 attached strings on a success. Each string can also be attacked and destroyed individually (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The puppeteer can only have strings attached to one creature at a time, and it can detach its strings from a creature as a bonus action.

actions.name: Puppet (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The puppeteer attempts to take total control of a creature that has at least one of the puppeteer's strings attached to it. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the puppeteer for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the puppeteer has a telepathic link with the creature, which it can use to issue commands to the creature. In addition, whenever the creature makes a Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, it uses the puppeteer's bonus for that check, unless its own bonus is higher. The charmed creature takes only the actions the puppeteer chooses, and doesn't do anything that the puppeteer doesn't allow it to do. The puppeteer can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires the puppeteer to use its own reaction as well. Each time the creature takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The puppeteer moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 1-2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The puppeteer casts a spell from its list of at will spells (1 actions) or 3/day spells (2 actions).

legendary_actions.name: Snap (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The puppeteer snaps its fingers creating a sonic boom that is audible out to 300 feet. Each creature within 30 feet of the puppeteer must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of the puppeteer's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned. The puppeteer can't use this legendary action while it has strings attached to a creature.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Nox Flower
sb.damage_resistances: the damage type corresponding to the nox flower's color (see prismatic bloom trait)
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Prismatic Bloom
traits.desc: The nox flower is one of the following colors, and its corresponding damage type affects several of its statistics: red (fire damage), orange (acid damage), yellow (lightning damage), green (poison damage), blue (cold damage), or purple (thunder damage).

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: If damage reduces the nox flower to 0 hit points, it explodes in a burst of pollen, unless the damage is necrotic. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) damage of the type corresponding to the nox flower's color, and the nox flower rolls a d4 to determine the additional effect creatures are subjected to until the end of their next turn: 1. The creature's speed is reduced by 5 feet. 2. The creature has disadvantage on the next ability check it makes. 3. The creature can't take reactions. 4. The creature must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action on its next turn; it gets only one of the three.

actions.name: Leaf Lash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 2 slashing damage.

sb.name: Physiker
sb.condition_immunities: poisoned

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the physiker is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the physiker instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The physiker's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Pointed Strikes (1/Turn)
traits.desc:
When the physiker hits a creature with a blowgun needle or unarmed strike, it can choose one of the following options:

- **Disable.** The next attack roll the target makes before the end of the physiker's next turn is made with disadvantage.
- **Expose.** The next attack roll made against the target before the end of the physiker's next turn is made with advantage.

traits.name: Stunning Strike (Recharge 5–6)
traits.desc: When the physiker hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned until the end of the physiker's next turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the physiker is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The physiker makes three attacks. It can use its Restoring Touch in place of one attack.

actions.name: Blowgun Needle
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Embolden (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The physiker casts the [[Tools/Spells/Enhance Ability|enhance ability]] spell. When cast in this way, the spell has a range of 20 feet.

actions.name: Restoring Touch (4/Day)
actions.desc: The physiker touches a creature or harmlessly launches a blowgun needle at a creature within 20 feet of it. The target regains 30 (4d8 + 12) hit points. Once a creature regains hit points in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a short or long rest.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: When the physiker is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it deflects the missile, reducing the damage it takes from the attack by 19 (1d10 + 14). If the damage is reduced to 0, the physiker catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the physiker has a hand free. It can then make a ranged weapon attack with the caught missile, which has an attack bonus of +7, a normal range of 20 feet, and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 7 (1d6 + 4) damage of the missile's type.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.desc: If the bruiser successfully grapples or shoves a creature on its turn, or if it is already grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it can use its bonus action to make one fist attack against that creature.

traits.name: Brute
traits.desc: The bruiser deals one extra die of damage when it hits a creature with a melee attack (included in the attack).

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the bruiser is wearing no armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bruiser makes two fist attacks. It can attempt to grapple or shove a creature in place of any attack.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the demolitionist is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the demolitionist instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Trap Adept
traits.desc: The demolitionist has advantage on any ability check it makes to set, disarm, or search for traps.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The demolitionist makes two rapier attacks. It can use its demolitionist's fire or bomb in place of one attack.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Demolitionist's Fire (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage. Hit or miss, each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or ignite. A flammable object in the area that isn't being worn or carried automatically ignites. Until a creature uses an action to extinguish a creature or object ignited in this way, it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Bomb (3/Day)
actions.desc: The demolitionist ignites the fuse of one of its handheld bombs, tossing the bomb to a point it can see within 30 feet of it. The bomb then detonates, exploding in a 10-foot-radius sphere of fire and shrapnel. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and 5 (2d4) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Defensive Combatant
traits.desc: Hostile creatures provoke opportunity attacks from the knight when they enter its reach. If the knight takes the Dodge or Search action, it has advantage on opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two glaive attacks. It can take the Dodge or Search action in place of one attack.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Polaris Magistrate
sb.languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The magistrate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The magistrate is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The magistrate can cast magic missile and detect thoughts at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] *, [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]], [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Slow|slow]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]]
- **5th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|mislead]], [[Tools/Spells/Modify Memory|modify memory]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|disintegrate]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|mass suggestion]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Reverse Gravity|reverse gravity]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]] *
- **9th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Meteor Swarm|meteor swarm]], [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|time stop]]

*The magistrate casts these spells on itself before combat.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

sb.name: Preserver Drone
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Guidance System
traits.desc: Whenever the drone hits a target with an attack, the next attack roll a preserver makes against that target before the end of the drone's next turn has advantage.

traits.name: Immutable Form

Immediately after the ooze suffers acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, or radiant damage, its nature changes to match that type. If the ooze suffers damage of two or more of these types simultaneously, the ooze chooses which type to adopt. The damage type for this property returns to acid when the ooze completes a short or long rest.

traits.desc: The ooze absorbs the optical qualities of crystals it touches. While the ooze is touching a transparent or translucent crystal formation of its size or larger, it is considered to be lightly obscured from any creatures that might see it. If the ooze is touching such a crystal at the end of its turn, and has not moved or taken an action since the start of its last turn, it is invisible instead. The invisibility lasts until the ooze moves, takes an action, or is no longer touching the crystal formation.

traits.name: Prismatic Form
traits.desc: A creature or object that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) damage of the type associated with the ooze's Prismatic Nature trait.

actions.name: Pseudopod

traits.desc: Raikya deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Raikya that isn't incapacitated and Raikya doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge

traits.name: Raven Servant
traits.desc: The acolyte can cast [[Tools/Spells/Find Familiar|find familiar]] as a ritual. When it does so, the familiar takes the form of a raven, but it has an Intelligence of 6, can understand Common, and has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The acolyte is a 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Eyebite|eyebite]]

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

actions.desc: The hag magically animates a Large or larger tree she touches, corrupting it. Twice while transformed, it can stop the line short and continue in a different direction for up to the remaining length of the line before transforming back into its normal form. The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny dragonchess piece. actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Crush (Dwarf/Oliphant)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword (Hero/Warrior)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Dragon; Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The dragon piece exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Healing Touch (Unicorn; 2/Day)
actions.desc: The unicorn piece touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

reactions.name: Fiery Retaliation (Elemental)
reactions.desc: When a creature touches the swarm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the elemental piece deals 5 (1d10) fire damage to that creature.

reactions.name: Overrule (King; 1/Day)
reactions.desc: When the swarm misses with an attack, the king piece orders it to reroll the attack roll, and it must use the new roll.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge (Thief)
reactions.desc: The thief piece halves the damage that the swarm takes from an attack that hits it. The swarm must be able to see the attacker.

sb.name: Swarm of Cacophony Crows
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The swarm doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium cacophony crow. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Beaks
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (6d4 + 4) piercing damage, or 14 (4d4 + 4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the swarm can't use its talons on another target.

actions.name: Screech (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The swarm emits a thunderous screech. Each creature within 90 feet of the swarm must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (5d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute; a stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

sb.name: Swarm of Lux Moths
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The swarm sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius.

traits.name: Obscuring Shroud
traits.desc: Creatures behind the swarm are heavily obscured. Other creatures are blinded while they are within the swarm's space.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny moth. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Intimidating Facade
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the swarm can shape itself to assume any Medium-sized silhouette, including that of any creature the swarm has seen. While a creature is further than 30 feet from the swarm, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) check to identify the nature of the silhouette.

actions.name: Disrupting Flashes
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) radiant damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) radiant damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Entrancing Pattern (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The swarm illuminates their bodies and swirls in a mesmerizing pattern. Each other creature within 30 feet of the swarm that can see it and isn't a moth must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by the swarm for 1 minute. A creature charmed by the swarm can perceive no creatures other than the swarm, and is only minimally aware of their surroundings. A creature charmed by the swarm can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition for it on a success. The condition ends immediately if the creature starts its turn without line of sight to the swarm, or starts its turn more than 60 feet from it.

sb.name: Swarm of Nox Flowers
sb.damage_resistances: the damage type corresponding to the swarm's color (see prismatic bloom trait)
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond that radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Prismatic Bloom
traits.desc: The swarm is one of the following colors, and its corresponding damage type affects several of the swarm's statistics: red (fire damage), orange (acid damage), yellow (lightning damage), green (poison damage), blue (cold damage), or purple (thunder damage).

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: If damage reduces the swarm to 0 hit points, it explodes in a burst of pollen, unless the damage is necrotic. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw; creatures within 15 feet of the swarm make this saving throw with disadvantage. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) damage of the type corresponding to the swarm's color and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. The swarm rolls a d8 to determine the additional effect poisoned creatures are subjected to until the poison ends: 1-2. The creature's speed is halved. 3-4. The creature is frightened. 5-6. The creature is blinded. 7. The creature is stunned. 8. The creature is paralyzed.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny nox flower. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Leaf Lash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) slashing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Pollen Burst (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The swarm erupts with a burst of destructive pollen in its vicinity. Each creature within 15 feet of the swarm (other than itself) must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) damage of the type corresponding to the swarm's color on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the swarm has half its hit points or fewer, this saving throw is made with advantage.

sb.name: Swarm of Skeletal Ravens
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The swarm can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as people whispering, babies crying, or animals chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 8 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.desc: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Beaks
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

sb.name: The Red Queen
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, poisoned

traits.name: Impose Will (5/Day)
traits.desc: The Red Queen can issue one of the following orders.

traits.name: Cower
traits.desc: When the Red Queen hits a target with her glaive, she can force all hostile creatures within 15 feet of her to succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of her until the end of her next turn. The target of the attack has disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: Execute
traits.desc: Immediately after the Red Queen makes an attack with her glaive on her turn, she can command a willing creature to use its reaction to make one weapon attack. The creature must be able to see and hear her. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Survive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the Red Queen can grant a creature other than herself a 10 temporary hit points. The creature must be able to see and hear her.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Red Queen's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. She can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 16), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hellish Rebuke|hellish rebuke]] (as a 2nd-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]]

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Red Queen is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|burning hands]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|shatter]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]]
- **4th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Red Queen can use her Pillar of Defense if she hasn't moved yet this turn. She then makes four glaive attacks.

actions.name: Red Queen's Burden (Glaive)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Pillar of Defense (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The Red Queen's speed becomes 0 until the start of her next turn. For the duration, she gains the following benefits: y She gains a +2 bonus to AC. y She can use her reaction up to three times, instead of once, before the start of her next turn. She can use no more than one reaction per turn. y When a creature within 10 feet of her makes an attack against her or another target, she can use her reaction to make a melee attack with her glaive against the attacking creature. y When she hits a creature with an attack using her glaive, that creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Battle Decree (5/Day)
traits.desc: The Violet King can issue one of the following orders.

traits.name: Clemency
traits.desc: When the Violet King casts a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a single creature, he can use his reaction to cause a different creature within 10 feet of the original target to regain 4 (1d8) hit points per spell level. When he does so, each creature has advantage on the next ability check or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Condemn
traits.desc: When the Violet King casts a spell that deals damage to a single creature, he can use his reaction to cause that target as well as a different creature within 10 feet of it to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) fire damage and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much fire damage and makes its next attack roll as normal.

traits.name: Overrule
traits.desc: After the Violet King rolls dice to restore hit points to a single creature or rolls damage for a spell attack or an attack using his rapier, he can change the result of two of those dice to their highest number possible instead of the numbers he rolled.

traits.name: Bonded Weapon
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the Violet King can summon his rapier, causing it to teleport instantly to his hand.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Violet King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. He can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 18), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hellish Rebuke|hellish rebuke]] (as a 2nd-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]]

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Violet King is an 11th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). He knows the following bard spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Vicious Mockery|vicious mockery]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Heroism|heroism]], [[Tools/Spells/Silent Image|silent image]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|unseen servant]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|tongues]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|disintegrate]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Violet King makes two rapier attacks and casts a cantrip.

actions.name: Violet King's Promise (Rapier)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

reactions.name: Superior Parry
reactions.desc: When the Violet King or a creature within 5 feet of him would be hit by an attack, he adds 5 to the target's AC against that attack. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding his rapier.

sb.name: Twigling
sb.languages: understands Druidic and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the twigling remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary stick.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Throw Seed
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 10/20 ft., one target. Hit: 3 bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Twilight Valkyrie
sb.damage_resistances: necrotic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: darkvision 300 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. At the start of the valkyrie's turn, she chooses either necrotic or radiant damage; when the valkyrie hits with any weapon that turn, the weapon deals an extra 11 (2d10) damage of that type (included in the attack). The valkyrie can't choose the same damage type two rounds in a row.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The valkyrie doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Twilight Aura
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the valkyrie can begin shedding an aura of twinkling starlight in a 30-foot radius around herself, which lasts until her concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). For the duration, all bright light and darkness within the aura magically becomes dim light; a creature with darkvision can't see in this dim light as if it were bright light. The valkyrie and her allies have half cover while in the aura.

traits.name: Valkyrie's Providence
traits.desc: The valkyrie can't be surprised and has advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The valkyrie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. She can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 20), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Sanctuary|sanctuary]] (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Harm|harm]], [[Tools/Spells/Heal|heal]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|flame strike]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The valkyrie can use her Divine Charge or cast one spell. She then makes two glaive attacks.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic or radiant damage (see Angelic Weapons trait).

actions.name: Divine Charge (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The valkyrie moves up to her speed in a straight line; this movement ignores difficult terrain and allows her to move through a hostile creature's space, regardless of its size. Each creature in the line must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) radiant damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the valkyrie's path and knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

reactions.name: Censure
reactions.desc: When a creature the valkyrie can see within 60 feet of her succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, she forces the creature to reroll the d20 and use the lower roll.

sb.name: Undulator
sb.damage_resistances: psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 300 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 18

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The undulator deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Tendrilous Aura
traits.desc: The ground within 60 feet of the undulator is filled with mindless, writhing tentacles made of shadow that extend 5 feet into the air. A hostile creature's speed is halved in the area, it has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or escape being grappled or restrained, and opportunity attacks against it are made with advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The undulator can use its Resonate. It then makes three attacks, only one of which can be with its beak.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The undulator has twelve tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Resonate (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The undulator emits a sonorous, mind-altering tone. Each creature within 60 feet of the undulator that can hear it must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes charmed by the undulator for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the undulator has a telepathic link with the creature and always knows the creature's location as long as it and the creature are on the same plane of existence. Whenever the undulator or one of its allies deals damage to the charmed creature, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the undulator's Resonate for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The undulator makes a Wisdom (Perception) check. It can do so using its senses, or using the senses of one creature of its choice that is charmed by it.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The undulator moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Compelled Strike (Cost 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The undulator magically forces one creature charmed by it to use its reaction, if available, to make an attack against a target of the undulator's choice that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Slam (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The undulator slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the undulator's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Valiant
sb.condition_immunities: frightened

traits.name: Heroic Resistance
traits.desc: Whenever the valiant finishes a short or long rest, it can choose either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The valiant has resistance to that damage type until it chooses a different one with this trait.

traits.name: Repelling Blast
traits.desc: When the valiant hits a creature with eldritch blast or its Eldritch Blade, it can push the creature up to 10 feet away from it in a straight line.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The valiant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 15), requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Dead|speak with dead]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|mass suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Slow|slow]]

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The valiant is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Eldritch Blast|eldritch blast]] (3 beams, +4 to each damage roll), [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/True Strike|true strike]]
- **1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Beacon Of Hope|beacon of hope]], [[Tools/Spells/Blur|blur]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Find Steed|find steed]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Heroism|heroism]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The valiant makes three Eldritch Blade attacks. It can make an attack with its longsword in place of one Eldritch Blade attack.

actions.name: Eldritch Blade
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 4 necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Vengeful Shield (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: When the valiant is hit by an attack, it casts the [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]] spell, without expending a spell slot and requiring no components. For the duration of the spell, whenever a creature attacks the valiant (including the triggering attacker), that creature takes 10 force damage.

sb.name: Vault Scanner
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vault scanner has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The vault scanner's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The vault scanner deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.desc: The vault scanner can't be surprised. In addition, it can take the Search action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vault scanner uses its Aim Lock. It then makes two attacks with its slam or beam.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Beam
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d12) radiant damage.

actions.name: Aim Lock
actions.desc: The vault scanner attempts to lock onto a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the vault scanner has advantage on attack rolls against the target until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Laser Cannon (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The vault scanner charges its cannon and unleashes a single massive beam of energy in a 5-foot-wide line that is 60 feet long. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 (5d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target is disintegrated if this damage leaves it with 0 hit points.

traits.name: Brute
traits.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the warlord hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Nimble Mind
traits.desc: The warlord can take the Help or Search action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The warlord has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warlord's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warlord makes three attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage in melee or 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage at range.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The warlord adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the warlord must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Wicked Wagon
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Coven Cart
traits.desc: The wagon counts as a hag for the purpose of forming a coven with two other hags.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The wagon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Capture
traits.desc: If the wagon or one of its allies riding in it kills a humanoid, that creature's soul becomes trapped in the demiplane inside the wagon. A trapped soul remains in the demiplane until the wagon is destroyed, or until it is targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell or similar magic, releasing all trapped souls. While a creature's soul is trapped in the demiplane, a hag riding in the wagon can use an action to magically transform, assuming that creature's appearance. While transformed, the hag gains access to enough information that it can reliably pass itself off as that creature to a casual acquaintance of the creature. A creature can discern the hag's true nature by succeeding on a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the hag's Charisma (Deception) check. The hag reverts to its normal form if it is ever more than 1 mile away from the wagon.

traits.name: Witch's Spire
traits.desc: The wagon can use a bonus action to assume its Gargantuan spire form, standing on chicken-like legs and raising the wagon 30 feet into the air. It stays in this form until it uses a bonus action to revert to its wagon form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wagon makes two snatch attacks.

actions.name: Snatch (Spire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The wagon has two arms, each of which can grapple only one target. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points while grappled in this way dies and is subjected to the wagon's Soul Capture trait.

actions.name: Overrun
actions.desc: The wagon moves up to its speed in a straight line. During this movement, it can move through the space of any creature or object that is Large or smaller, and it doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Each target in its path must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.
